about_short_description.short_description: Diriyah Company offers property development, project planning, residential sales, leasing, asset management, and investment solutions.

product.name: Master Planning and Development
product.description: Planning and development of Diriyah’s integrated cultural, residential, hospitality, retail, office, and public-realm assets, including infrastructure and heritage-sensitive urban development.

product.name: Investment and Development Partnerships
product.description: Investment opportunities and partnership structures for developing infrastructure, residential, hospitality, retail, office, education, healthcare, parking, and mixed-use assets within Diriyah.

product.name: Residential Sales
product.description: Sales of residential properties within Diriyah, including homes designed as part of a pedestrian-oriented mixed-use community with access to retail, offices, entertainment, and public spaces.

product.name: Hospitality Development
product.description: Development of hotels and resorts in Diriyah, combining international hospitality operations with architecture, services, and guest experiences rooted in Saudi and Najdi heritage.

product.name: Retail Leasing
product.description: Leasing of retail and dining spaces in Diriyah to local and international brands, restaurants, and other consumer-facing businesses.

product.name: Office Leasing
product.description: Leasing of office space in Diriyah for businesses seeking workplaces with supporting amenities, facilities, and technology within an integrated urban development.
